How much does tile installation cost in Bellevue, WA?

Tile installation in Bellevue costs about $14 to $26 per square foot installed, counting tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor. Labor alone starts at $11 per square foot. A standard tub-shower surround runs $3,200 to $6,800, and a full bathroom with floor, shower and niche usually lands between $6,500 and $14,000. Tile format drives the price more than tile price does: large-format and mosaic sheets take significantly more labor per square foot than 12×12.
How much does it cost to tile a shower in Bellevue?

A tiled shower in Bellevue runs $3,200 to $6,800 for a standard alcove, including demolition, a bonded waterproofing system, the pre-sloped base or pan, tile setting, a niche and grout. Curbless entries, benches, full-height stone and steam showers push above that. The waterproofing is roughly a tenth of the cost and prevents the one failure that costs tens of thousands.
Do you waterproof showers before tiling?

Yes. Every shower we tile gets a bonded waterproofing system behind the tile, not just cement board and thinset. That means a pre-sloped base, a sheet or liquid membrane carried up the walls, sealed corners, seams and pipe penetrations, and a documented 24-hour flood test before a single tile goes on. Tile and grout are not waterproof; the membrane behind them is what keeps water out of your framing.
How long does a bathroom tile job take?

A bathroom tile job in Bellevue takes about four to six working days: one day for demolition and dust protection, one for substrate and waterproofing plus a 24-hour flood test, one to two for setting tile, and one for grout, silicone and trim. Add 24 hours of cure time before the shower is used. Floors on their own are usually one to two days.
Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?

Porcelain is the better choice for floors, showers and anything that gets wet or heavy traffic: it is denser, absorbs less than 0.5% water, and chips less. Ceramic is fine for walls and backsplashes and costs less. In Bellevue we specify porcelain for every floor and shower floor, and let ceramic or glass earn its place on walls and backsplash.
Can you install a heated tile floor?

Yes. Electric radiant mat under tile adds about $11 to $16 per square foot installed including the thermostat, and it is the cheapest luxury in a Bellevue bathroom because it is only worth doing while the floor is already open. It goes in over an uncoupling membrane, is resistance-tested before and after setting, and runs on its own dedicated circuit.
Do I need to remove the old tile first?

Usually yes. Old tile removal and haul-away runs about $3.50 per square foot, and it is the only way to see the subfloor, check for rot or movement, and get the new floor height right at doorways. Tiling over existing tile is possible on a sound, flat, well-bonded floor, but it raises the floor and hides problems we would rather find at demolition than after grout.
How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Bellevue?

A kitchen backsplash in Bellevue costs $1,100 to $2,200 for a typical 30 square foot run, installed with outlet cuts, edge trim and color-matched grout. Mosaic sheets, herringbone layouts, a picture-frame detail behind the range and full-height slab-look porcelain sit at the top of that range because of layout and cutting time.
Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?

Often, yes. Tile repair and regrout starts at $8 per square foot and is the right call when grout is stained or crumbling, a few tiles cracked from an impact, or shower corners need the grout cut out and replaced with silicone. If tiles sound hollow, are popping loose in a pattern, or the wall feels soft, the substrate below has failed and a repair only buys months — we tell you which one you have before we quote.

We tile homes across all of Bellevue — West Bellevue, Downtown, Crossroads, Lake Hills, Factoria, Somerset, Newport Hills, Eastgate, Wilburton, Bridle Trails, Northwest Bellevue, Woodridge, Cougar Mountain and Clyde Hill — plus Kirkland, Redmond, Issaquah, Sammamish, Mercer Island and the wider Eastside and Seattle.
What warranty comes with tile installation?

You get a 2-year workmanship warranty from OC Flooring on tile installation, longer than we give on carpet because tile failures show up in year two, not week two. Bonded waterproofing systems carry the manufacturer's own warranty when we install their full assembly, and we photograph the membrane and the flood test so the record exists if you ever sell the house.
